finalists.label: Papillary Intralymphatic Angioendothelioma (PILA)
finalists.why: It has the most specific and detailed evidence, including irregular red lacunae, absence of septa, and ectatic thin-walled vessels with intravascular branching papillary structures.

finalists.label: Hemangioma
finalists.why: It has a broad range of evidence, including the presence of a red nodule, well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor, and ectatic thin-walled vessels, although some findings are not specific to this candidate.

finalists.label: Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia
finalists.why: It has some specific evidence, including irregular red lacunae and absence of septa, but lacks detailed histopathological findings.
